result.summary: Design complete for ISS-0174 / GH-502. Decision RETAIN. Five substitution rules (S1-S5) for the Zig 0.15 managed -> 0.16 unmanaged ArrayList API migration in src/lua/capabilities.zig (lines 49-60): replace .init with .empty, pass allocator to deinit/appendSlice/toOwnedSlice. Longjmp-unsafe contract documented on summary()'s doc comment (mirroring writeGrants in src/lua/host_context.zig). New test block in src/lua_test_root.zig calls summary() for real (replacing the bare-type pin at line 95) with five test cases TC-CS-01..05 covering empty/single/multi-grant rendering, allocator honouring, and caller ownership. Sorted-join determinism chosen over insertion-order because std.StringHashMap iteration order is undefined. Deliberate-mutation verification procedure specified for BACKEND-DEV Step 3 (inject const _bad: u32 = 'definitely not a u32', run zig build test-lua, expect red, revert, expect green). SHOULD-1 (function-level census) and SHOULD-2 (linter upgrade) deferred to follow-up runs; rename and deletion rejected.
result.design_decision: RETAIN and migrate. The function is the legitimate non-longjmp utility for host-API startup diagnostics, audit log lines, and REST error responses for missing capability metadata. Deletion would silently regress ISS-0169 / GH-495 ERR-2 architecture (the writeGrants / summary split).
